claims.claim: A detectable BUB1B expression response qualifies a specific disease surrogate.
claims.support: BUB1B target RNA is suppressed and the RPE1 response exceeds the selected-control reference.
claims.challenge: Own-target retrieval is weak among essential-gene responses; one guide pair and no protein/function restoration.
claims.falsifier: Independent perturbation/restoration or relevant functional endpoints fail despite an expression effect.
claims.decision: HOLD model qualification; retain RPE1 as an assay comparator.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Demonstrate independent attribution, division fidelity, daughter fate and later function.
claims.reopening_criteria: Demonstrate independent attribution, division fidelity, daughter fate and later function.

claims.claim: The non-targeting export provides an unselected negative-control sensitivity.
claims.support: The plan explicitly requested core versus all-control analyses.
claims.challenge: Both sets contain exactly the same retained cells: RPE1 11485, K562 10691.
claims.falsifier: Membership equality prevents the proposed sensitivity from testing control-selection bias.
claims.decision: Reject the claimed sensitivity; preserve documented amendment and missing comparison.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Recover independent or unselected controls; do not use more random splits as a substitute.
claims.reopening_criteria: Recover independent or unselected controls; do not use more random splits as a substitute.

claims.claim: A BUB1B signature transfers across cell contexts if MTOR agrees.
claims.support: MTOR has strong cross-cell expression matching.
claims.challenge: BUB1B correlation is 0.1043 with query transcripts removed, with ranks 980/2077 and 386/2154.
claims.falsifier: Relevant BUB1B functional response differs between contexts despite a transferable reference target.
claims.decision: HOLD cross-cell transfer; evaluate each context separately.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Measure common functional endpoints in qualified non-cancer and tumour models; retain separate objectives.
claims.reopening_criteria: Measure common functional endpoints in qualified non-cancer and tumour models; retain separate objectives.

claims.claim: Many cells, paired guides and repeated splits establish independent replication.
claims.support: The dataset contains 106 RPE1 and 141 K562 BUB1B cells and 1024 splits per cell type.
claims.challenge: One paired-guide construct is shared across cell types; resampling reuses cells and controls.
claims.falsifier: A new construct or restoration control does not reproduce the attributed effect.
claims.decision: Reject biological replication/CI claims from these counts.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Obtain independent perturbation and appropriate restoration evidence.
claims.reopening_criteria: Obtain independent perturbation and appropriate restoration evidence.

claims.claim: New mTOR-related studies establish uniform mechanism, safety or benefit for MVA.
claims.support: Selected tumour biomarker and pediatric regimen findings are favorable in their own settings.
claims.challenge: Primary clinical futility, context dependence, existing renal/infection risks and yeast cohesion findings remain.
claims.falsifier: Model-relevant target engagement fails to improve joint function or worsens division/fate/injury.
claims.decision: No drug promotion; keep exposure margins null and safety override.
claims.next_discriminating_action: Measure pathway direction, relevant exposure, joint response and injury in the qualified model.
claims.reopening_criteria: Measure pathway direction, relevant exposure, joint response and injury in the qualified model.
